scope: Users can manually set Applied, Recruiter Contact, Interview, Offer, Rejected, and Withdrawn in the connected Applications UI. Each change is recorded with USER_REPORTED attribution, appears in history, remains durable after page reload, and does not create a submission receipt or invoke external submission.

environment.frontend: local Vite production build and Chromium

checks.evidence: All 9 pipeline integration tests passed. Coverage includes user-reported status/history persistence after Store reopen, profile isolation, invalid states writing no history, all supported workflow states, idempotency conflicts, and concurrent ordered history.

Connected local Chromium selected every required status, observed USER_REPORTED API responses and visible history, reloaded the app, and read all six events back from the Applications UI. External network requests were blocked and none were attempted.
TypeScript and Vite production build passed. Existing advisory: generated JavaScript chunk exceeds 500 kB.

not_run: Hosted Actions or external review (disabled by local-only policy)
limitations: The broader tests.browser.test_core_workflow_trial journey was attempted but did not reach its status assertions; existing scheduled-search selectors/messages failed first. The focused connected status browser test passed independently.
Status evidence remains user-reported and does not establish that an employer received an application.
safety: Applied status remains separate from submission confirmation and operational application state.
Status history is profile-scoped; foreign-profile reads and writes return 404 in integration tests.
The browser test used only synthetic local data, blocked external network requests, and confirmed external_submission_enabled is false.
